jobs.occupation: Pig Farm Employee Wanted for Modern Pig Production in Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you interested in pig production and looking for a stable, long-term job in Denmark? We are looking for a motivated and reliable employee to join our team at a modern pig farm near Fjerritslev in North Jutland.

This is a permanent full-time position with the opportunity to become part of a professional and international team.

About the Farm

We operate a modern pig production with:

• 1,500 sows

• Approximately 50,000 finishing pigs annually

• A team of Danish and international employees

We offer a friendly working environment where teamwork, responsibility, and good animal care are highly valued.

Job Responsibilities

The position is primarily within the sow unit and includes:

• Breeding and gestation management

• Daily care of sows and piglets

• Piglet processing, including castration

• Moving pigs between sections

• Cleaning and washing barns (approximately once per week)

• General farm and production-related tasks

You should be able to work independently, but support from colleagues is always available.

We Are Looking For Someone Who

• Has an interest in pig production

• Enjoys working with animals

• Can work independently and take responsibility

• Is a positive team player

• Speaks English

• Holds a valid driver's licence

Experience from farming or livestock production is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience with pig production or castration is considered a plus.

What We Offer

• Permanent employment

• Average of 37 working hours per week

• Work every second weekend

• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

• A supportive and international work environment

• Opportunity for long-term career development

Working Hours

Monday to Friday

• Typically from 07:00 to 16:00

• Earlier finish on Fridays when possible

Breaks

• Morning break: 09:00 - 09:30 (bread provided by the employer)

• Lunch break: 12:00 - 12:30

Weekend Schedule

• 07:00 - 12:00

• Approximately 30 minutes of work around 16:00

Accommodation

Accommodation is available on the farm within walking distance of the workplace.

Options include:

• Private room

• Apartment

Rental terms and price will be agreed individually.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Interested?

For more information or to apply, please contact:

Frederik Damgård

HR Advisor

jobs.occupation: R&D Project Manager
jobs.description:
Do you have the ability to lead multiple product development projects at different stages and keep a clear overview to ensure timely delivery with the right quality? If so, you might be our new R&D Project Manager.

We offer a position with a diverse portfolio of projects—from simple to highly complex—where you will play a key role in driving innovation across software, mechanics, electronics, and sustainability. You will join a skilled Engineering team of specialists in mechanical design, electronics, and software.

**Project Management with a Focus on Structure and Communication

**You will be responsible for planning and executing your own projects from the early specification phase to production release or customer handover. This includes managing communication with internal stakeholders and external suppliers throughout the project lifecycle. You will handle several projects simultaneously, each at different stages. Most importantly, you will ensure alignment with the product roadmap and timelines, including:

• Estimating project scope, budget and timeline in collaboration with specialists and key stakeholders

• Effective project planning, including scheduling and booking internal resources

• Ensuring strong collaboration within the project organization and with subcontractors

• Driving progress while keeping a close eye on technical solutions, risk management, and cost control

• Supporting and clarifying concepts that align with the company’s as well as our customers’ focus areas, such as IoT, Industry 4.0, and sustainability

This is an independent and challenging role where you will have plenty of opportunities to influence the development of cutting-edge solutions.

Although our activities span the globe and our customers include some of the biggest brands in the appliance industry, this position is primarily internally focused, with only limited travel required.

**Your Background

**You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (B.Sc or M.Sc) or an equivalent academic qualification, giving you a solid foundation to act as a trusted partner for our business. In addition, we expect that you:

• Have 5+ years of experience as a project manager, preferably within the field of mechatronic

• Possess strong technical understanding within electronics, software, or mechanics

• Have a detail-oriented, structured, and consistent approach to your work

• Have solid financial insight and understanding

• Value well-documented project processes

As a person, you are an accomplished project leader who knows how to bring a team together and deliver optimal results. You are an excellent communicator who fosters collaboration across all functions without losing sight of the project goals. You maintain focus and overview throughout the entire process, ensuring strong results through close internal and external contact.

Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level is a must.

**What We Offer

**As a Project Manager, you will enjoy a dynamic workday involving collaboration with suppliers and colleagues worldwide. AGRAMKOW is a make-to-order company, giving you a broad interface with sales, engineering, development, purchasing, and production. Your workplace will be at our headquarters in Sønderborg, and physical presence is required. This is not a hybrid or remote position.

AGRAMKOW is the leading supplier of sustainable end-of-line solutions to manufacturers in the refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pump industries. The company is headquartered in Sønderborg and employs 180 people in Europe, Asia, North America and South America. The sales and service staff is supported by an extensive network of partners, ensuring local support for all customers.

jobs.occupation: Property Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**

_Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

_

**Responsibilities

**

Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

**Your responsibilites will typically include:

**

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

**About you

**

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg. cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: BMS A/S Region Öst Hvidovre - Köpenhamn söker kranförare till mobil tornkran
jobs.description:
På grund av ökad aktivitet söker vi en stabil, självständig och ansvarsfull kranförare som sätter säkerhet och kundnöjdhet i centrum vid utförandet av uppdrag i Region Öst. Din fasta utgångspunkt kommer i första hand att vara i Hvidovre.

Arbetsuppgifter

• Utföra kranuppdrag, bedöma arbetsuppgiften på plats och genomföra den säkert och effektivt i samarbete med kunden.

• Följa gällande säkerhetsföreskrifter.

• Hålla fordonet/kranen rent samt utföra mindre reparationer.

• Rapportera fel och brister på fordonet/kranen till verkstaden.

• Ge god service till kunderna.

Kvalifikationer och kompetenser

• Du har gärna erfarenhet från liknande arbete.

• Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta i team.

• Du vet vad det innebär att vara en professionell kranförare och vilka krav det ställer på dig.

• Du är flexibel när det gäller arbetstider.

• Du tar ansvar, är målmedveten och har ett smittande engagemang.

• Du är pålitlig och stabil.

• Du talar och förstår danska och engelska.

• Du har krankort B och gärna E.

• Du har körkort C/E.

• Du har digitalt förarkort.

• Du har yrkeskompetensbevis (YKB) för godstransporter.

• Du har truckkort.

Vi erbjuder

Ett spännande och självständigt arbete med många utmaningar, stor frihet under ansvar och en informell arbetsmiljö. Vi erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor med bland annat tjänstepension, sjukvårdsförsäkring och en aktiv personalförening.

Vi säkerställer en grundlig utbildning i körning av mobil tornkran.

Efter avslutad utbildning får du ansvar för din egen mobila tornkran.

Ansökan

Har tjänsten fångat ditt intresse? Skicka då gärna en kort ansökan så snart som möjligt genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök om tjänsten”.

Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

BMS A/S är Danmarks ledande leverantör av krantjänster. Därutöver har vi betydande verksamhet inom lastbilsliftar, tunglyft, transporter och uthyrning av körplåtar. Våra skickliga medarbetare servar dagligen kunder inom bland annat bygg- och anläggningsbranschen, industrin, telekomsektorn, olje- och gasindustrin samt vindkraftsbranschen.

BMS A/S är en del av BMS-koncernen, som totalt har över 2 000 medarbetare verksamma i bland annat Danmark, Sverige, Norge, Finland, Tyskland, Polen, Storbritannien, USA och Australien. År 2025 utsågs BMS-koncernen till världens sjätte största kranföretag av den internationellt erkända tidskriften International Cranes & Specialized Transport.

Såfremt du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte

Claus Helbo Nielsen

Afdelingsleder

chn@bms.dk

Tlf.: +45 4457 0717

jobs.occupation: Head of Data Platform
jobs.description:
Head of Data Platform – build Gubra’s data foundation from the ground up

Do you want to build the data foundation behind scientific innovation in a growing biotech company? Gubra is looking for a Head of Data Platform to take end-to-end ownership of a new enterprise data platform connecting scientific, operational, and business data across the organisation.

This is a director-level role combining technical ownership, people leadership, and greenfield development. You will shape the architecture and roadmap, build the team around the platform, and remain close enough to the technology to take part in key technical decisions.

The ambition is to create a scalable data foundation that supports research, laboratory operations, machine learning, and selected business functions across Gubra.

Build the platform – and the team around it

Gubra is investing in its digital and data foundation, and you will join at an early stage.

As Head of Data Platform, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of the platform, built around AWS and Databricks. You will work across architecture, data pipelines, reusable data products, governance, and security while translating scientific and business needs into technical priorities.

At the same time, you will build and lead the data engineering team. Two Data Engineers are planned to join, an external Data Architect is already supporting the initial design, and the team is expected to grow further. You will report directly to the CTO and become part of the CTO’s leadership team.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading the design and development of a scalable and secure enterprise data platform

• Building reliable data pipelines and reusable data products for scientists, ML teams, engineers, and business users

• Defining the platform roadmap and driving key architectural and technical decisions

• Establishing data governance, security, access control, and documentation standards

• Building, mentoring, and developing the data engineering team

• Working closely with stakeholders across research, laboratory operations, software engineering, and the wider business.

Who are you?

You have a strong background in data engineering, analytics, or data platforms and experience leading both people and technical delivery. You combine leadership with enough technical depth to challenge architectural decisions and engage credibly with engineers.

You bring extensive experience with AWS and Databricks and have designed scalable, secure, and governed data solutions before. Experience with lakehouse architecture, data mesh, medallion architecture, Airflow, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog is an advantage.

Experience from biotech, pharma, life sciences, or another research-intensive environment is beneficial but not required. The same applies to experience with regulated environments and GxP.

Personally, you are a pragmatic and collaborative leader who can create a clear direction, bring stakeholders and employees with you, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

About Gubra

Gubra is a purpose-driven biotech company where technology, data, and science come together to create life-changing therapies. The organisation combines Biotech, CRO, and Venture activities and brings scientists, engineers, and business teams together across the organisation.

Digital, Data & IT is strengthening the foundation beneath this work by connecting scientific, operational, and business data and enabling advanced analytics and machine learning.

The position is based at Gubra in Hørsholm, Denmark.

If you have any questions about the position, you are always welcome to contact Kathrine Schlegel Rasmussen at ksr@capaxrecruitment.com.

Capax Recruitment manages the recruitment process on behalf of Gubra.

jobs.occupation: Principal Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Principal Enterprise Architect – shape the technology choices behind Gubra’s growth

Build, buy, integrate or simplify? As Gubra grows, so does the number and complexity of technology decisions across the organisation. Gubra is therefore looking for a Principal Enterprise Architect who can bring direction and coherence to its technology landscape.

In this newly established role, you will become a close architectural partner to the CTO and work across business, science, and technology. Your job is not to own one particular platform or technology. Instead, you will help Gubra make the right technology choices across scientific systems, enterprise applications, ERP, data, AI, cloud, and integrations.

Turn complex needs into pragmatic technology choices

As Principal Enterprise Architect, you will work closely with business leaders, scientists, Product Managers, and technology teams to understand what they are trying to achieve before translating those needs into architecture options and recommendations.

That could mean assessing whether to build a capability internally or invest in a SaaS platform. Another could involve defining how a new solution should integrate with Gubra’s existing landscape, exploring an AI opportunity, or helping a new venture establish a technology foundation that works today without limiting it tomorrow.

You will also help establish the architecture principles, standards, and guardrails that create consistency across Gubra. The ambition is not architecture for architecture’s sake, but enough direction to enable teams to make better decisions independently.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Advising on technology choices across enterprise applications, ERP, data, AI, cloud, security, and integrations

• Evaluating COTS and SaaS solutions and supporting build-vs-buy decisions

• Defining and evolving architecture principles, standards, and reusable patterns

• Translating business and scientific needs into pragmatic architecture recommendations

• Working with Software, Data, ML, Infrastructure, and Security teams to ensure decisions are technically viable

• Identifying opportunities for AI and modernisation across the organisation

• Following developments within AI, cloud, data sovereignty, and emerging technologies.

An architect who asks the right questions

You bring 5+ years of relevant experience as an Enterprise Architect, Principal Architect, or in a similar role, with broad experience across enterprise applications, data, cloud, integrations, security, and modern software platforms.

You understand ERP and enterprise business systems and how they connect to a broader technology landscape. You are comfortable discussing APIs, integration patterns, identity, security, cloud architecture, and data interoperability, and you have experience assessing COTS or SaaS platforms and making technology recommendations.

You also understand modern AI architecture and how AI capabilities can become part of real business workflows. Experience from pharma, biotech, life sciences, drug discovery, or another R&D-intensive environment is relevant, while experience with GxP is an advantage.

Just as importantly, you are curious enough to challenge the problem before proposing the solution. You can discuss opportunities with business leaders and scientists and then go into sufficient technical depth with engineers to make decisions credible and implementable.

You are comfortable influencing across teams without formal authority and know when architecture adds value – and when it simply adds another layer of complexity.

Where science, business and technology meet

Gubra is a purpose-driven biotech company where technology, data, and science come together to create life-changing therapies. Its activities span Biotech, CRO, and Venture, creating a technology landscape that needs to support different business models, scientific disciplines, and ways of working.

Digital, Data & IT works across these areas to create the digital foundation supporting both scientific innovation and business operations. As Principal Enterprise Architect, you will have a broad view across that landscape and help ensure technology decisions support where Gubra is going next.

The position is based at Gubra in Hørsholm, Denmark and reports directly to the CTO.

If you have any questions about the position, you are always welcome to contact Kathrine Schlegel Rasmussen at ksr@capaxrecruitment.com.

Capax Recruitment manages the recruitment process on behalf of Gubra.

jobs.occupation: Start your career as an Audit Graduate at Deloitte Copenhagen 2027
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 2700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

Would you like to start your audit career at Deloitte's head office?

At our Copenhagen office you will get 600 Audit & Assurance colleagues across departments. We have a strong sense of community, with many joint events, from Friday bars to courses and development opportunities. This gives you plenty of opportunity to build a strong network and a foundation for where your career at Deloitte will take you.

Job Description

As an audit graduate, your day-to-day work will take place in either our Portfolio or Large & Complex departments. You will be assigned to one of our four client segments: Public, Private, Financial Services, or Top Tier and your daily work will be team-based. You will have a dedicated department manager and a coach to support your personal and professional development.

You will quickly become part of your new community and have ample opportunity to build new relationships.

As an audit graduate you:

• Always work in audit teams and be in close contact with both colleagues and clients - often working on site at the client's premises.

• Acquire extensive knowledge of your department's clients and, most importantly, the skills to advise and audit them.

• Assist in planning client's audits, coordinating efforts with, for example, Deloitte's Service and Delivery Centres, which handle many of our administrative tasks, ahead of the reporting season.

• Contribute to risk assessments of accounting areas, using your knowledge of the client's internal processes.

• Work with an experienced audit team to conduct audits to ensure that the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Your role will vary depending on which department you join but we promise that your days will not be the same. There will be room to learn, to ask for help, and to grow and take on the responsibility you want.

NEXT - our graduate development programme

When you join as an audit graduate, you enter a full-time role and will join our internal development programme, NEXT, along with around 100 other graduates across the country. You are regularly brought together for training and to prepare for new roles.

Depending on where you are in your training when you join us, you will also be studying part-time at the university. And for your first 100 days with us, you will be assigned a buddy who has been through the experience of being a new graduate and will help you settle into your new role.

Qualifications

There are several paths to become an audit graduate in our audit business. We are open to your educational background and to you completing a level of training while you are with us. The most important thing is that you have the interest and motivation to learn. And it is important that you:

• Want to develop personally.

• Are curious about auditing.

• Have social skills that will support your future relationships with clients and colleagues, and team-based working.

• Can show relevant professional experience or extra curricular activities , in which you have excelled.

• You speak and understand both English and Danish, or any of the other Nordic languages.

• You are eligible to work within the EU, either as a citizen or with the correct permits.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Click on "I am interested" above to apply for this position.

Please attach your CV and grades from your current and previous education. Please do not upload a traditional cover letter. Through the application process we will also ask you to answer a few questions about your motivation for the joining Deloitte.

We process applications and arrange interviews continually.

Expected start date to be 10.09.2027.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard on mobile: +45 53793260 or email: talent@deloitte.dk

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.occupation: Global Business Services (GBS) Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimize, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance. We work in the full lifecycle of projects from strategy to design and implementation.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Manager to join our Global Business Services (GBS) team. The ideal candidate has experience in setting up shared services organizations and a deep understanding of multi-functional GBS operations. Experience with the interplay of technology and process design in this context is preferred. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, building effective governance structures, implementing new capabilities globally and optimizing functional processes leveraging the latest technologies.

Job Description

As a GBS Strategy Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. In this role, you will architect future-ready GBS strategies, drive end-to-end finance process transformations, and leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to enable growth and value creation. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations, setting up shared services or outsourcing solutions, and leveraging a commercial mindset to position and scale innovation. You will identify, design, and implement shared services solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies, and organizational agility.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Identifying key client business issues and architecting end-to-end finance process transformations (e.g., R2R, O2C, P2P)

• Driving business development by responding to Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and pitching strategic solutions with a strong commercial mindset

• Evaluating and deploying innovative technologies, including GenAI and intelligent automation, to elevate client digital maturity and process performance

• Determining which techniques, delivery models, and emerging tech are best suited to serving each client's unique addressable needs

• Developing recommendations for the client in the context of overall engagement

• Leading day-to-day team activities and effectively overseeing the quality of deliverables

• Managing diverse small and big teams

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in the GBS, Shared Services and/or Business Process Outsourcing, as well as good understanding of finance processes

• 3+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with multiple GBS pillars including, but not limited to HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Commercial Operations, Legal

• Extensive project experience within the Shared Services, Outsourcing and/or Offshoring industry, or back-office functional optimization

• Experience with service delivery model strategy, design, implementation & optimization for multi-functional or single-function entities

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

jobs.occupation: Computational and Data Staff Scientist Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design
jobs.description:
We seek an experienced, highly motivated, and independent computational and data scientist to support the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design (CPD), University of Copenhagen (UCPH). The post suits someone with experience in computational chemistry, biology, and/or structural biology, as well as managing big data. This is a full-time position, starting 1 February 2027 and employment through 31 July 2032.

  Our research
 The CPD is a new initiative at UCPH. It is a multidisciplinary centre that works across the university—notably with the Departments of Biology, Drug Design and Pharmacology, Chemistry, and Computer Science—and with national and international academic and industrial partners. CPD is funded by an initial grant of 700M DKK for seven years from the Novo Nordisk Foundation. At capacity, the CPD is expected to have ≈8 research groups, ≈80 researchers, and support staff. Research will encompass the growing protein design landscape with computational, experimental, applied and hybrid projects.

  The CPD's vision and mission are to accelerate protein design by deepening understanding of sequence-to-structure/function relationships in proteins, and to train the next generation of protein scientists to apply protein-design approaches and methods to a diverse array of fundamental and real-world challenges.  

  CPD research is broadly organised into three themes: Programmable De Novo Protein Design, aimed at improving methods for protein design by combining rational, physics-based and AI-based approaches; Contextualised Protein Design, that is, designing proteins that are fit for purpose such as working directly and optimally in cells, chemical reactors, etc; and Biodesign for Sustainability and Healthcare, for instance working with biotech and industry to deliver synthetic proteins to address grand challenges in these areas.

  Data science at CPD: Increasingly, modern protein science is about data: collecting it, organising it, analysing it, and learning from it to build a deeper understanding of how proteins fold and function. Protein design is no different. Indeed, through the application of generative AI, it is at the leading edge of the confluence of data science and protein science. To coordinate this in the CPD, we are looking for someone experienced in and excited about working at this interface.

  Further information on the CPD see: cpd.ku.dk.

  Learn more about the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, https://drug.ku.dk/

  Your job
 Specifically, we seek a talented computational and data scientist and team player to help develop research infrastructure, including hardware and computational tools, to advance the CPD’s research and mission. The successful candidate will join a growing multidisciplinary team to help collect, organise, analyse, and exploit data from computationally designed protein sequences and structural models, through protein expression levels, and onto a wide range of experimental structure-function studies. A key part of the role will be integrating into the wider team and working collaboratively with CPD researchers, rather than simply providing a data-management service. For example, we anticipate that the successful candidate would assist with and lead on various projects with CPD researchers to develop robust, reliable, and scalable data and computational tools to enable the very best protein design.

  Key responsibilities will include

   	
• Helping establish CPD's computational infrastructure to provide computing and data management for its researchers 	
• Developing automated pipelines that convert raw instrument output files directly into data plots suitable for analysis, saving time and resources across the research pipeline 	
• Collecting data and generating databases of designed proteins, e.g., constructs, sequences, models, and biophysical data (LIMS) 	
• Assisting in the development of new predictive models based on the gathered experimental and computational data using machine learning methods 	
• Being responsible for data management plans at the CPD and coordinating these plans with the host departments 	
• Related to the above, managing (i.e., best practice in collecting, organising, accessing) data generated by computational protein design workflows and by the CPD’s Protein Biophysics Facility 	
• Advising and training CPD scientists in creating and analysing large computational datasets, linking their experimental data and computational data to extract key information, and managing their computational protein design pipelines 	
• Contributing to, and where appropriate leading, grant applications for and publications from CPD research projects 	
• Teaching appropriate aspects of the above on CPD Master’s and PhD courses 	
• Serving as the primary technical bridge between the CPD and central KU IT to set up CPD’s computing systems in close collaboration with KU IT and establish internal data processing environments   Qualifications and expectations
 To succeed in this role, we anticipate that your areas of expertise could include one or more of the following:

   	
• Computational protein modelling and, ideally, design 	
• Protein or biomolecular sequence data and analysis 	
• Collection, manipulation and use of data from protein biophysics and structural biology 	
• Use and understanding of modern biomolecular statistical data analysis, including ML and AI methods, and generative AI for protein modelling and design 	
• Experience of establishing computational infrastructures for the above   Essential experience and skills

   	
• A PhD in bioinformatics, data science or a related domain, e.g. computational/structural biology 	
• Excellent knowledge of scientific computing and coding languages, e.g., Python 	
• Documented experience (e.g., scientific publications) in machine learning, scientific computing, and similar 	
• An active interest in protein design, engineering, and structure  	
• A proven ability to work with others on challenging multidisciplinary problems 	
• A team player keen on collaborating with researchers from different backgrounds and who is service-minded with clear organisational, communication, and networking skills. 	
• Excellent skills in written and spoken English   Desirable experience and skills

   	
• Knowledge of experimental protein science, for example, biophysical methods and/or structural biology 	
• Experience in computational molecular/structural biology   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the NNF Center for Protein Design, located at the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative, stimulating working conditions in a dynamic, international research environment.

  Salary and terms of employment
 The employment is a full-time (37 hours/week) position with a fixed-term until 31 July 2032. The starting date will be 1 February 2027.

  Depending on qualifications the position will take place as Special Consultant or Senior Consultant in accordance with the Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority), with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experience and qualifications. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.
 You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For further information regarding the position, please contact Center Manager Gretchen Repasky, Gretchen.repasky@bio.ku.dk.

  Application
 Your application should be in English and include:

   	
• A cover letter outlining your fit to the role and motivation for applying (max. one page). 	
• Curriculum Vitae (incl. the names of two referees) (max. two pages)  	
• List of publications including preprints (no limit, but do not include copies of the papers) 	
• A certified/signed copy of certificate(s) of education   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below.

  Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not meet the above requirements.

  The University wishes to reflect the diversity of the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.
 The University of Copenhagen has established a new shared administrative organizational structure, which is currently being implemented. This entails ongoing changes and the development of, among other things, workflows and interfaces for collaboration. 

  As part of the International Alliance of Research Universities (IARU) and among Europe’s top-ranking universities, the University of Copenhagen promotes research and teaching to the highest international standard. Rich in tradition and modern in outlook, the University gives students and staff the opportunity to cultivate their talent in an ambitious and informal environment. An effective organisation – with good working conditions and a collaborative work culture – creates the ideal framework for a successful academic career.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Sustainable Indoor Solar Cells for Ambient Light Energy Harvesting in IoT Applications - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you interested in developing thin-film solar cells designed to operate efficiently under indoor lighting and thereby contributing to the green transition? 

At DTU Electro, you will have the opportunity to break new ground by harvesting energy from ambient light and help pave the way towards sustainable technologies.

The Thin-Film Photovoltaics Group at DTU Electro is seeking candidates for a PhD Scholarship focused on the development and characterization of highly efficient Sb₂S₃ solar cells. You will investigate materials, interfaces, and device architectures to understand and overcome the fundamental limitations of photovoltaic performance under low-light conditions.

The position is offered within the framework of DTU’s Alliances and Strategic Partnerships with Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech), Estonia. You will be part of an international research collaboration combining thin-film synthesis, solar-cell fabrication, advanced optoelectronic and defect characterization, and device testing under realistic illumination conditions. As part of the PhD project, you will undertake a research stay at TalTech and work closely with researchers from both universities.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The PhD project focuses on developing high-efficiency Sb₂S₃ thin-film solar cells for indoor energy harvesting. The project will investigate how material properties, interfaces, and device architecture influence charge transport, recombination, and voltage losses under low-intensity illumination. The overall objective is to develop solar cells optimized for indoor light and demonstrate series-connected mini-modules capable of powering battery-free IoT devices.

Your primary responsibilities include:

• Develop and optimize Sb₂S₃ thin-film solar cells by engineering device architectures and interfaces to enhance charge collection while minimizing recombination and voltage losses under indoor illumination.
• Characterize solar cells under different LED spectra, light intensities, and illumination conditions relevant to realistic indoor environments.
• Investigate defect states, interface recombination, and open-circuit voltage losses, including advanced electrical characterization during a research stay at TalTech.
• Develop and characterize series-connected indoor photovoltaic mini-modules for battery-free IoT applications.
• Supervise and contribute to MSc/BSc student projects.
• Document and disseminate the research through scientific publications and international conference contributions
You should have a strong academic background in physics, chemistry, materials science, nanotechnology, or a related field. Prior knowledge of semiconductor physics and photovoltaics, and experience with thin-film materials, solar-cell fabrication, optoelectronic characterization, or indoor photovoltaics, would be particularly valuable.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the candidates will be made by Senior Researcher Stela Canulescu. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms. 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is the 1 February 2027. The position is a full-time position. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from the Senior Researcher Stela Canulescu, email stec@dtu.dk.

You can read more about the Department of Electrical and Photonics Engineering at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Quant Infrastructure Student
jobs.description:
Are you a talented hacker with a passion for data engineering and building things that actually run in production? Do you enjoy working close to the metal, solving real problems, and seeing your code go live within hours?

Then you might be the next Quant Infrastructure Student joining our team at Alipes!

About Alipes

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in automating financial markets since our inception in 2008, pioneering fully automated natural language processing systems to read and interpret financial news.

To accomplish our goal of being the best at what we do, we are focused on building a world-class ML engineering workflow, ensuring seamless training, deployment and monitoring of our predictive models.

What you’ll do

• You’ll help us build and improve the ML infrastructure powering our fully automated trading systems. Expect hands‑on work with:

• Python tooling for data processing and rapid model experimentation.

• Scalable pipelines for dataset generation, feature engineering and model training.

• Distributed computing technologies (e.g., Ray, Kubernetes).

• Internal utilities that make it easier for researchers to prototype, validate and deploy models.

• Improving latency, reproducibility and monitoring in our deployment workflows.

You’ll work closely with quantitative researchers and ML engineers, contributing directly to production‑grade systems.

About the team

You’ll join an informal, highly technical Quant team where ownership matters and good ideas move fast. We’re a tight-knit group of researchers across 9 nationalities, all with strong backgrounds in math, modeling, and machine learning - and everyone writes code. We collaborate closely with our software developers and traders, working together on models end‑to‑end and engaging deeply in the technical details that make them work.

About you

• You don’t need years of experience, but you do need curiosity, strong fundamentals, and a willingness to build things that work. You are currently studying either a Bachelor's or Master's in Denmark. We’re looking for someone with:

• A scientific and inquisitive mindset.

• Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures & algorithms).

• Strong Python skills, especially around data preprocessing or pipeline building.

• Interest in distributed systems or ML Ops.

• Experience working with datasets that don’t fit in memory.

• Familiarity with at least one strongly typed language (C#, C/C++, Rust, etc.).

• Currently enrolled in a technical BSc/MSc program (CS, engineering, math, physics, etc.).

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with ML workflows (dataset generation → training → evaluation).

• Exposure to distributed computing frameworks (Ray, Spark, Dask).

• Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experience with ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost or CatBoost.

• Interest in algorithmic trading concepts.

• Personal projects that show you like to hack on things, automate stuff, or optimize pipelines.

What we can offer you

• Competitive benefits, including health insurance and 25 days of vacation.

• A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV, and attach your BSc and/or MSc grade transcripts to your application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

If you have specific questions about the role, you are welcome to email us at quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please do not send in your applications to this email address, as our interview team will not have visibility to review.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, QC BioAssay
jobs.description:
We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role as Senior QC Scientist (BioAssay)

Are you motivated by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up? Genmab is establishing a QC Laboratory, and we are looking for a Senior QC Scientist for a BioAssay team to play a central role in this work.

This is a unique opportunity to help implement methods, shape key processes, and set the standard for how our QC organization will operate in the years ahead.

You will play a key role in the establishment of the laboratory which includes and is not limited to: Method transfers, Validation of Analytical methods, authoring and reviewing laboratory procedures, and supporting qualification of new analytical instruments.

Collaboration and cross-site training with our analytical development group in Utrecht and analytical SME´s in Copenhagen will also be expected in the beginning

The position is an onsite role in our QC Lab in Ballerup and reports to Associate Director, Head of QC BioAssay

Once in operation daily tasks includes:

• Reviewing release and stability analyzes,

• Supporting and training fellow scientists and lab technicians

• Documenting validation activities of analytical methods for clinical phase I/II and III and authoring SOPs.

Requirements

• Master's degree or PhD in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, biotechnology, or related scientific area.

• At least 6+ years of experience in a Quality Control (QC) or analytical development (AD) laboratory or a PhD degree with 3+ years of working experience.

• Strong understanding of analytical science and its application across clinical development stages.

• Good understanding of validation concepts, risk-based approaches, and regulatory expectations.

• Experience with systems and tools relevant to QC (e.g. LIMS, SAS-Jmp, SoftMaxPro)

• You have experience with ELISA´s and pharmacopeia methods for biologics.

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to shape a laboratory from the ground up. You will be part of a highly motivated and international team, working with cutting-edge science and innovative therapies. If you are energized by challenges, driven by curiosity, and eager to see your impact on both processes and people, we want you on the team.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role:

We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Senior Medical Director to be a part of our Global Clinical Development Team.

The Medical Director will be accountable for the medical oversight of one or more clinical trials, medical review and communication of data, and medical input into regulatory documents and presentations.

Responsibilities

• Lead the development of the program strategy for assigned trials/compounds and participate in the development of the clinical development plan (CDP)

• Lead creation and review of clinical components of key documents, clinical and regulatory documents, annual safety updates, and registration dossiers (ie, protocol, ICF, IB, annual safety updates, study reports, regulatory submissions [Briefing documents, IND, Clinical dossiers] supporting registration, market access, and commercialization of the compound(s)

• Oversee safety of the drug, including the safety aspects of patients in clinical studies and signal detection with support of the Safety physician

• Create, integrate, and execute overall medical strategy of assigned clinical development programs; provide strategic medical advice on potential new projects (internal & external)

• Contribute to publication and clinical communication strategy in coordination with Scientific Communications; provide inputs to key external presentations

• Provide strategic input and development support for clinical plans and individual trial protocols

• Interact with key opinion leaders to ensure implementation of the latest clinical and medical thinking and guidelines into clinical development plans, as well as consideration of novel medical methods development and new po

• Contribute to medical department best practices, standardization and to cross-functional process improvements

• Support the development of case report forms, perform medical monitoring, liaise with investigators and site personnel, perform preliminary and exploratory data analyses on clinical trials, author clinical study reports, provide input on publication materials, and participate in advisory boards.

• Contribute to publication and clinical communication strategy in coordination with Scientific Communications; provide inputs to key external presentations

• Support the development of other relevant documents that are necessary for the advancement of the product pipeline

• Serve as medical and technical resource for clinical issues raised by internal and external collaborators, investigators, consultants and contractors

• Create medical deliverables: clinical development plans, concept sheets, briefing books, and label and marketing application dossier

• Contribute to medical input to preclinical development of candidate therapeutic antibodies

• Drive and monitor quality of all clinical documents (e.g., Investigators’ Brochures, protocols, study reports, clinical components of regulatory submissions, safety documents) produced by CDT

• Interact with key opinion leaders to ensure implementation of the latest clinical and medical thinking and guidelines into clinical development plans, as well as consideration of novel medical methods development and new potential targets.

• Participate in multi-function teams necessary for the advancement of the product pipeline

• Attend relevant congresses or other relevant fora to maintain up-to-date scientific/medical knowledge

Requirements

• MD background with a minimum of 3+ years of directly related industry experience within oncology or hematology

• Significant experience with relevant areas of oncology

• Proven ability to build and lead teams and inspire trust among colleagues

• Experience representing team and organization in a variety of internal/external settings

• Experience training and managing team members

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK1.041.600,00---1.562.400,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in System Dynamics Modelling and Adolescent Health
jobs.employer_name: KU - SUND - Institut For Folkesundhed - Kbh K
jobs.description:
A three-year position as a Postdoctoral researcher is now available at the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen. The Postdoc’s employment is expected to start on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  About the Center

  You will be employed at the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, which aims to build a strong scientific foundation for understanding and acting on complex public-health challenges. The Center leverages multi-layered nationwide social and health data combined with an interdisciplinary fusion of methods spanning data science, epidemiology, ethnography, econometrics, and systems science. Our research focuses on the complex interplay of health, social, and environmental factors that shape individuals, families, and networks over time. We emphasise interdisciplinary collaboration, offering you an opportunity to actively engage as a collaborative partner in different projects depending on your interests and expertise. Learn more about the Center and our research, vision, and values here.

  About the Department 

  The Department of Public Health provides the scientific foundation for researchers and educators who aim to improve public health, both nationally and globally, and to create greater insight into the links between health, the individual, and society as well as the ethical, equity, and political implications. This is achieved through research, education, and engagement with stakeholders and the general public along with a broad multidisciplinary research agenda that addresses most aspects of public health at a high international level. More information about the Department of Public Health is available here.

  About the position 

  The position will be nested within the Child Health group at the Center, where we advance knowledge through a combination of research activities that leverage the Center’s data infrastructures and methodological expertise, and engagement with policymakers and practitioners. The Center has developed a strategic partnership with a Danish municipality – the Thriving Communities Lab – which offers a platform for connecting the scientific activities at the Center with real-world health promotion efforts. The focus of this partnership is to enhance the conditions for adolescents to thrive through a dynamic learning process that involves professionals across sectors in the municipality, the local government, and researchers, over a period of several years. One question we will explore is whether computational modelling can usefully bring together local knowledge, scientific evidence, the Center’s data resources, and insights emerging from practical interventions, and so strengthen this learning process. Your work as a postdoc will be anchored around this question. Our vision at the Center is to build on this experience to engage with more municipalities over time, addressing a variety of complex health challenges.

  As a Postdoc, your responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

   	
• Spearheading the development of a decision-support/scenario exploration tool that offers policymakers a way to visualize and simulate systemic effects of social investments and programmes, in close collaboration with our partners in the Thriving Communities Lab. 	
• Engaging with municipal collaborators within the Thriving Communities Lab to ensure a dynamic interplay between research activities and local efforts. 	
• Exploring multi-layered life-course data from the Danish Life Course Cohort (DANLIFE), augmented with local data from the municipal partner, to map the interrelated landscape of well-being among adolescents. 	
• Contributing to scientific publications and engage in the dissemination of research results related to these topics. 	
• Collaborating with researchers in the Center on interdisciplinary projects. 	
• Participating in research-based teaching at the Department of Public Health. 	
• Actively contributing to the development of organisational elements within the Center, such as network activities, website, outreach initiatives, social engagements, scientific meetings, and more.   Profile 

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic researcher with the following competences and experience:

   	
• You have a PhD degree in social science, economics, epidemiology, data science, complexity science, computational science, or other related sciences. 	
• You have experience with system dynamics modelling. Experience with agent-based modelling, social return on investment analysis or other analytical frameworks to model social and systemic impacts of social policies and programmes would also be an advantage. 	
• Experience working with Danish register data is an advantage. 	
• You are motivated to engage in participatory processes with practitioners and policymakers, and to collaborate with a variety of stakeholders to foster change. 	
• You have an active interest in complex-systems science applied to public health and epidemiology. 	
• You have proficient communication skills and a proven ability to work in interdisciplinary teams. 	
• You have excellent English skills, both written and spoken. 	
• Danish language skills are an advantage but not essential.   Place of employment

  The place of employment is the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen, next to the Lakes in Central Copenhagen.

  Terms of employment 
 The average working hours are 37 hours per week. The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is February 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or another relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 35,000 DKK/approx. 4,700 EUR (October 2021 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 17.1 % to your pension fund. Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark for the past 10 years. The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

  Further information

  For specific information about the position, please contact the Associate professor Christopher Jamil de Montgomery: cmon@sund.ku.dk

  Applicants may find the following links useful:

   	
• Copenhagen Health Complexity Center: https://healthcomplex.dk/ 	
• University of Copenhagen: http://ku.dk/english/ 	
• Department of Public Health: http://publichealth.ku.dk/ 	
• International Staff Mobility: https://ism.ku.dk/   Application process

  Your application should be written in English and must include the following documents – all in PDF format:

   	
• Letter of motivation (max 1 page). Please briefly describe your previous research experience and interests as well as what attracts you to the position. 	
• Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 	
• Certified/signed copies of
 	a) PhD certificate (if the PhD has not been completed, a written statement from the applicant’s supervisor will suffice)
 	b) Master of Science certificate. 	
• A research plan (max 2 pages) outlining your ideas for how a decision-support/scenario exploration tool could be developed, drawing on system dynamics modelling or other analytical frameworks suitable for modelling dynamic effects of social policies and programmes.   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be considered.

  After the expiration of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager will select applicants for assessment based on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been advanced for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment has been completed, each applicant is given an opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant themselves.

  You can read more about the recruitment process here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  Application deadline 

  Deadline for applications: 31/10/2026 23.59pm CET 

  We reserve the right to reject material received after the deadline, and to reject applications that do not meet the abovementioned requirements.

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 47-48.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of their personal background.

Job Description

• 
Job ID: 361751

• 
Date posted: 27.10.2026

Who you are

Do you take pride in working in the early morning? If so, you are a good match as a forklift driver for our goods receiving department. When IKEA opens at 10 AM, it is important we have replenished the shelves so we are ready for our customers.

In addition we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle hard manual labor

• Thrive by working during the early morning hours

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• It is an advantage if you hold a Danish forklift license, or a forklift license from a EU, EEA country or Switzerland, which is eligible for approval by Arbejdstilsynet.

What you'll be doing day to day

As a forklift driver you play an important part for IKEA’s customers and sales, because you and your team make sure our home furnishing solutions and accessories are always accessible for our customers. Every day is fast paced because we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Your tasks will be:

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Handling of goods and stock taking, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department.

Together as a team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Service Execution Team Leader Maksas Botyrius -maksas.botyrius@ingka.ikea.com

Other information

• This position is for an average of 10 hours per week

• Working hours are every second Saturday from 05:00 AM to 10:00 AM, as well as weekday mornings between 05:00 AM - 10:00 AM. It is possible to give your input to the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!
